p.i: Et nostra si quid audiendum vox dabit,
Vos me putastis esse ludum que & iocum
Vos ne videret gurgites, ne pasceret
Nullum periclum, nulla monstri est vastitas

page.notes: Drop-cap M at the start of the poem "In Leonoram". Some ink marks and stains in the margins, not transcribed. Possible misreadings in the long-s and ligature forms of the italic type, marked as printed.
